stages.name: 00_read_control
stages.title: Read the Control workbook
stages.note: Validates Params, Layers, Trend, Completion and the other sheets. A scenario_id lists the overrides applied.

stages.name: 01a_adapter_line
stages.title: Adapter: line data
stages.note: Members and claim lines to the internal schema; rejected and unmatched lines are counted in the reconciliation.

stages.name: 01b_adapter_claimant
stages.title: Adapter: claimant listing
stages.note: Claimant listing, monthly exposure and aggregate claims to the internal schema.

stages.name: 01c_adapter_ete
stages.title: Adapter: Merit / ETE outputs
stages.note: Merit's dim_life, fact_member_month and fact_claims to the internal schema. A16 flags a pooled run, A18 / A19 count the benefit-limit sources.

stages.name: 02_experience
stages.title: Treaty-year experience
stages.note: Exposure and claims by treaty year on the chosen basis. Indicated completion factors: copy the ones you accept into the Control workbook (Completion sheet).

stages.name: 03_burning_cost
stages.title: Per-person burning cost
stages.note: Trended, capped and annualised large claims; burning cost per layer with credibility.

stages.name: 04a_fit_severity
stages.title: Severity fit (candidates)
stages.note: Candidate distributions above the fitting cut-off; the selected one (lowest AIC, or fit_selected) feeds the simulation.

stages.name: 04_simulate
stages.title: Per-person simulation
stages.note: Frequency × severity simulation per layer; expected loss blended with the burning cost by credibility. The longest stage. A layer attaching below fit_cutoff is handled by Params below_cutoff (STOP / EMPIRICAL / IGNORE): out_sim_summary shows lambda_band and mean_recovery_band, checks S08–S11 say what was done.

stages.name: 05_per_event
stages.title: Per-event XoL
stages.note: Event grouping, event burning cost and simulation; empty tables when no EV layer is defined.

stages.name: 06_stop_loss
stages.title: Aggregate stop loss
stages.note: Attritional model, gross and net aggregate distributions, structure quantiles and reinstatement usage.

stages.name: 07_results
stages.title: Results workbook
stages.note: Writes the data sheets of XoL_Results.xlsx. Close the workbook in Excel before running this stage.
